name: board-pack
title: Board meeting pack
for_each: select id,title from meetings where status<>'cancelled'

sections.title: Meeting
sections.sql: select b.name as board,m.title,m.meeting_date,m.status from meetings m join boards b on b.id=m.board_id where m.id=$1

sections.title: Agenda
sections.sql: select a.position,a.title,a.purpose,m.name as presenter from agenda_items a left join members m on m.id=a.presenter_id where a.meeting_id=$1 order by a.position

sections.title: Paper summaries and archive references
sections.note: Linked source documents remain in your controlled archive. This pack does not merge their contents.
sections.sql: select p.title,p.summary,p.source_path,p.received_on from papers p join agenda_items a on a.id=p.agenda_item_id where a.meeting_id=$1 order by a.position,p.title

sections.title: Open actions for this board
sections.sql: select a.title,m.name as owner,a.due_date,a.note from actions a join members m on m.id=a.owner_id where a.board_id=(select board_id from meetings where id=$1) and a.status in ('open','in-progress') order by a.due_date

sections.title: Current interests
sections.sql: select m.name as member,i.title,i.nature,i.extent,i.disclosed_on from interests i join members m on m.id=i.member_id where i.board_id=(select board_id from meetings where id=$1) and i.closed_on is null order by m.name

sections.title: Recorded minutes
sections.sql: select m.title,m.body,m.recorded_on,m.signed_on,s.name as recorded_signer from minutes m left join members s on s.id=m.signer_id where m.id=$1
sections.note: A recorded signature date is metadata. This document does not provide an electronic signature service.

sections.title: Attendance
sections.sql: select p.name,a.status from attendance a join members p on p.id=a.member_id where a.meeting_id=(select meeting_id from minutes where id=$1) order by p.name

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select title,body,outcome,decision_date from decisions where meeting_id=(select meeting_id from minutes where id=$1) order by title

sections.title: Current and historical disclosures
sections.sql: select m.name as member,i.title,i.nature,i.extent,i.aware_on,i.disclosed_on,i.closed_on from interests i join members m on m.id=i.member_id where i.board_id=$1 order by m.name,i.aware_on

name: action-notice
title: Action follow-up for review
for_each: select id,name from members where active

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select a.title,a.due_date,a.note,d.body as decision_context from actions a left join decisions d on d.id=a.decision_id where a.owner_id=$1 and a.status in ('open','in-progress') order by a.due_date
sections.note: Draft for the secretary. Nothing is sent.
